$Comment: The Great Turkey, the Turkey Graveyard's boss: the biggest of the hunted turkeys' souls, which only its fight's script raises (EncounterManager/Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter.json), from Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Marker once the waves of Turkey Souls are put down. It is a Variant of this pack's Harvest_Feast_Template_Great_Turkey (the Headless Horseman's foot template, the game's Gobliterator boss template, redone for a turkey), with its look (Models/Harvest_Feast/NPC/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey.json, the game's turkey drawn more than twice its size), its health, its name and its combat evaluator (CAE_Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey: its pecks, its charge, and the souls' ghostly sheen, Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul_Glow). Between pecks it charges at most every 12 seconds at a player within 14 blocks: it locks on for half a second, puffs up and gobbles for 1.2 seconds, unstoppable, with a warning marker on the ground ahead of it, then runs 16 to 20 blocks straight through where that player stood. A player it runs into takes the Burnt Praetorian's charge hit (30 Physical before armour, and a hard shove back); a charge that misses, or that a grave or a wall stops, leaves it dazed for 2 seconds (Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Dazed), taking half again the physical damage. Tune how often it charges and each peck in its evaluator, and the charge's hit, wind-up, distance, speed and daze in the template's parameters (CombatChargeHitEntityInteraction, CombatChargeWindupTime, CombatChargeDistance, CombatChargeSpeed, CombatStunTime). Its fight adds one health step per player beyond the first (the Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Scale_Health effects), calls more souls at half health and puts its fury on it at a fifth (Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Fury), so MaxHealth here is its health for a player alone. The template keeps it unshoved, awake and drops nothing, since its reward is the Claims its fight pays, and walks it back toward its fight whenever the fight calls it back past its LeashRange. It is in Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Group, which its fight binds and clears, and in no group Martha's favor counts. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
